  FROM partsupp ps
  JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
  JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  WHERE n.n_name = 'GERMANY'
  GROUP BY ps_partkey

  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,
  o.o_orderdate,
  o.o_shippriority
FROM
  customer c
  JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey

```sql
SELECT
  l.l_orderkey,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,
  o.o_orderdate,
  o.o_shippriority
FROM
  customer c
  JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
  JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
WHERE
  c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'
  AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-03-15'
  AND l.l_shipdate > '1995-03-15'
GROUP BY
  l.l_orderkey,
  o.o_orderdate,
  o.o_shippriority
ORDER BY
  revenue DESC,
  o.o_orderdate
LIMIT 10;
```

    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,

FROM orders o

ORDER BY revenue DESC, o.o_orderdate

    c.n_name AS cust_nation,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS l_year,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN nation n2 ON c.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
WHERE
    (n.n_name = 'FRANCE' AND n2.n_name = 'GERMANY')

    (n.n_name = 'GERMANY' AND n2.n_name = 'FRANCE')
    AND
    (l.l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate <= '1996-12-31')
GROUP BY
    s.n_name,
    c.n_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)
ORDER BY
    s.n_name,
    c.n_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)
